description: Transaction receipt on Mantle (eth_getTransactionReceipt): success or reverted, gas used, effective gas price, fee paid in MNT, number of event logs and any contract created. Use to confirm a payment or call went through; for sender, value and calldata use mantle_tx. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; a pending or unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0xa93012fcae16a5b4b9d6f7c7469ed2838cd27eb387b28e7334678add918d174f. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: mantle_receipt
title: Mantle transaction receipt
